limits: emit_line rejects a line that does not fit remaining bytes; failed subtraction does not zero the remaining count, so a later smaller line could still fit
Scope snapshots carry process_id, while the one-time log-limit sentinel does not; forwarded child snapshots can carry a child process_id although the parent emit_line consumes the parent's budget
the retained raw log has zero later phase lines, but missing original failures cannot be reconstructed from this or a fresh process
records are separately bounded to eight per Scope; unknown phases are never zero time

supersedes.correction: Scope snapshots contain process_id; the limit sentinel omits it. A forwarded child snapshot process_id identifies that snapshot source, not necessarily the parent emitter owning the log budget.
